name: runner-home-isolation
description: The runner gives the app command and every shell step a throwaway HOME (seeded, not the real one) and its own project root, and stops what a spec leaves running under it. A plain command, so the runner's defaults apply.

config.command: sh -c 'R=$(python3 -c "import os,pwd; print(pwd.getpwuid(os.getuid()).pw_dir)"); H=$(if [ "$HOME" != "$R" ] && [ -f "$HOME/.kollab/config.json" ] && [ -f "$HOME/.kollab/connect-guide-seen" ]; then echo ok; else echo bad; fi); P=$(if [ "$KOLLAB_PROJECT_ROOT" = "$HOME/project" ]; then echo ok; else echo bad; fi); echo "home-check=$H project-check=$P keyring-check=$KOLLAB_NO_KEYRING"; sleep 120'

steps.description: the previous run's stray process is gone
steps.command: P="${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/kollab-spec-runner-home.pid"; if [ -s "$P" ] && /bin/ps -p "$(cat "$P")" -o command= 2>/dev/null | grep -q kollab-spec-runner-home; then echo "stray left by the previous run"; else echo "no stray from the previous run"; fi
steps.assert_contains: no stray from the previous run

steps.description: app HOME is a seeded throwaway, not the real one, with its own project root
shell steps share the throwaway HOME
steps.command: python3 -c "import os,pwd; real=pwd.getpwuid(os.getuid()).pw_dir; h=os.environ['HOME']; print('shell home isolated' if h != real and os.path.isfile(h + '/.kollab/config.json') else 'shell home NOT isolated: ' + h)"

steps.description: leave a detached process under the throwaway HOME for the runner to stop
steps.command: python3 -c "import subprocess, sys; p = subprocess.Popen([sys.executable, '-c', 'import time; time.sleep(300)  # kollab-spec-runner-home'], start_new_session=True, stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL, stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL, stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL); open('${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/kollab-spec-runner-home.pid', 'w').write(str(p.pid)); print('stray started')"
